result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M while Licensor handles Licensee data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the unrelated representation-by-counsel provision. However, requiring all insurance to continue for one year after termination exceeds the playbook and is not necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL and workers’ compensation; the timing language also sits awkwardly with the separate cyber-duration qualifier.
